fit_reason: Whole SUV, a 2007 GMC Yukon, listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Yellowed, cloudy headlight lenses on the front, most visible on the driver side headlight
Faded, grayish black plastic on the front bumper lower trim and around the running boards
White paint on the hood and front bumper looks flat with no real gloss or reflection
Worn, creased leather with some shine on the driver seat bolster and cushion
Dust on the dash top and center console surfaces
Carpet in the passenger footwell and the rear cargo seatbacks looks dusty and could use a vacuum and shampoo
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Yukon. The headlights have gone yellow and cloudy in the photos, and the black trim on the front bumper looks faded. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including headlight and trim restoration, a polish on the paint and a cleanup of the leather and carpets. Would you like a quote?
